about: Volter Editor's Account settings key test for Tripo as it ships (volter-ai/editor b86dde8c5618, packages/editor-core/server/provider-credentials.ts): its own fetch, no Tripo SDK (the official one is Python), reads the balance with the Bearer key the World's credential door issues as TRIPO_API_KEY (an account credited 3000). A mistyped paste is refused (401) and the editor reports it; the issued key connects with code 0 and the account's balance. The readback tests the same key again after the World resumes, its account and credits retained, without issuing another.
